title: Gaussian white noise as an isometry
summary: W(A) ~ N(0, mu(A)) with Cov(W(A),W(B)) = mu(A cap B): splitting adds variance, overlap is covariance.
source: Le Gall, Brownian Motion, Martingales and Stochastic Calculus -- Ch.1, Gaussian white noise / definition of the isonormal Gaussian process
